name: Siddhant Khare
description:
Siddhant Khare is a software engineer working on AI agent infrastructure and authorization. He maintains OpenFGA and GitHub1s, created agent-trace, and wrote The Agentic Engineering Guide. He previously spent four years at Ona, formerly Gitpod, before its acquisition by OpenAI.

His essay “AI fatigue is real and nobody talks about it” reached #1 on Hacker News, was covered by Business Insider, and was cited on The New York Times’ Hard Fork podcast. His work focuses on scoped agent permissions, execution tracing, and human control of AI systems.
